age.evidence: At the completion of pre-training, when rats were between 8 and 9 weeks of age, a single dose of psilocybin (1.5 mg/kg)...was administered

sex.evidence: Female Sprague-Dawley rats (n = 22)... a separate cohort of female Sprague-Dawley rats... psilocybin (n = 8) or saline (n = 8)

dosing.evidence: a single dose of psilocybin (1.5 mg/kg; USONA Lot# AMS0167, dissolved in saline) or saline alone (control) was administered intraperitoneally

group_housing.evidence: Before training, rats were housed individually in specialised cages (26 cm W × 21 cm H × 47.5 cm D)

day_night_flipped.evidence: allowed to acclimate to the reverse light cycle (lights off at 11AM) for 7 days prior to any intervention

assays.assay_description: Two-armed bandit reversal learning task using FED3 devices placed in the home cage for 3 h/day across 14 consecutive days. Three possible actions (poke left, poke right, stay in cage); 10 pokes on the rewarded side triggered reversal. Measures included rewards, losses, win-stay, lose-shift, stay-in-cage, response vigour, and reversal rate.

setup_habituation.evidence: habituated to sucrose pellets sprinkled into the cage for two consecutive days. Pre-training involved first training animals to take pellets from the magazine... and subsequently training animals to make nose-poke responses

setup_restrain.evidence: completed the task in their home cage such that they could decide to either engage in the task or stay in the cage without engaging

food_restriction.evidence: The rats were maintained on ad libitum access to food (standard rat and mouse chow; Barastoc, Australia) throughout the entire experimental paradigm

time_to_assay.evidence: the first session beginning 24 h after treatment with psilocybin

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin-treated rats achieved more rewards (significant on days 7-14), had more losses on average (driven by fewer losses in controls on days 4-6), and spent significantly less time staying in the cage (i.e., greater task engagement). Computational modelling indicated higher forgetting rates for rewards, lower forgetting rates for losses, and reduced loss aversion over time in the psilocybin group.
outcomes.evidence: rats in the psilocybin group achieved significantly more rewards on days 7-14 compared to those in the control group... the control group selected the action of 'staying in the cage' significantly more than the psilocybin group

B1_num_measures.evidence: rewards, losses, win-stay, lose-shift, stay in cage, response vigour, reversal rate

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: behaviour analysed across days (between-session), not within-session temporal dynamics

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: win-stay and lose-shift behaviour analysed (trial-to-trial transitional structure)

B4_ethological.evidence: actions: 'poke left', 'poke right', or 'stay in cage' — operant choices, not natural ethological behaviours

B5_social.evidence: rats housed individually and tested alone in home cage

B7_automated_classification.evidence: behaviour recorded by FED3 nose-poke device, no pose estimation or ML classifier

B8_multivariate.evidence: logistic regression analyses with the parameters as predictors and group classification as the outcome variable

E2_shelter.evidence: home cage is an open single compartment; no separate enclosed refuge within the apparatus

E3_bedding.evidence: task performed in home cage (standard housing with bedding)

E6_spatial.evidence: home cage is a single compartment

E7_social_context.evidence: rats were housed individually in specialised cages

E8_food_water.evidence: maintained on ad libitum access to food... throughout the entire experimental paradigm; FED3 delivers food pellets in the cage

D1_continuity.evidence: 14 experimental sessions on separate and consecutive days

D2_session_duration.evidence: FED3 were placed in the home cage of the rat for 3 h a day

D3_recording_days.evidence: 14 experimental sessions on separate and consecutive days

assays.assay_description: Open field box (60 × 60 × 55 cm); single 10-min trial; primary measure distance travelled; secondary measure time in centre zone. Analysed with EthoVision XT.

application_type.evidence: administered psilocybin (n = 8) or saline (n = 8) and 24 h later were tested in the open field

setup_restrain.evidence: deep open topped box (60 × 60 × 55 cm deep)

food_restriction.evidence: no food present in the apparatus during the 10-min trial

water_restriction.evidence: no water present in the apparatus during the 10-min trial

time_to_assay.evidence: 24 h later were tested in the open field

sample_size.evidence: a separate cohort... psilocybin (n = 8) or saline (n = 8)

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin did not alter locomotor activity (distance travelled) or time in the centre/edge zones of the open field 24 h post-administration.
outcomes.evidence: Psilocybin did not alter locomotor activity or change the duration spent in risky or safe zones of either the OF (Fig. 5M-O)... all ps >0.3217

B1_num_measures.evidence: distance travelled... and proportion of time spent in the aversive ('risky') centre zone

B4_ethological.evidence: locomotor distance and zone preference time

B6_cognitive.evidence: anxiety/locomotion test based on innate avoidance

B7_automated_classification.evidence: analysed with Ethovision XT (V3.0; Noldus, NL) tracking software using centre of mass for detection

assays.assay_description: Elevated 4-arm Perspex platform (70 cm long × 10 cm wide × 90 cm high) with two closed and two open arms; 10-min trial; primary measure proportion of time spent in closed vs open arms. Analysed with EthoVision XT.

setup_restrain.evidence: Rats were placed in the centre platform facing an open arm

food_restriction.evidence: no food present in apparatus during 10-min trial

water_restriction.evidence: no water present in apparatus during 10-min trial

time_to_assay.evidence: 24 h later were tested in... the elevated plus maze

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin did not alter the proportion of time spent in open vs closed arms of the EPM 24 h post-administration.
outcomes.evidence: Psilocybin did not alter... the duration spent in risky or safe zones of either the OF (Fig. 5M-O) or EPM (Fig. 5Q, R; all ps >0.3217)

B1_num_measures.evidence: proportion of time spent in the closed arms relative to the open arms... was used as the primary measure

B6_cognitive.evidence: anxiety test based on innate avoidance

E1_environment_type.evidence: elevated 4-arm platform made of grey Perspex

E2_shelter.evidence: EPM closed arms are part of apparatus design, not a shelter

E6_spatial.evidence: EPM arms are open-ended extensions of a central platform per rubric

judge_notes: Three assays identified by all candidates: reversal learning task (FED3), Open Field Test, Elevated Plus Maze. No merging required beyond standardising names.

B1 for reversal task: scored 7+ (3 pts) — paper explicitly reports rewards, losses, win-stay, lose-shift, stay-in-cage, response vigour, and reversal rate as distinct measures (qwen and gptoss agreed).
B2 for reversal task: scored 0 — analyses across days are between-session, not within-session temporal dynamics per rubric.
B3 for reversal task: scored 1 — win-stay/lose-shift are trial-to-trial transitional measures.
E2 for reversal task: scored 0 — home cage is a single open compartment, no enclosed refuge within the testing apparatus (overriding qwen's score of 1).
E3 for reversal task: scored 1 — testing in home cage which contains bedding (following glm).
Water restriction for reversal task: scored not_reported — paper only explicitly states ad libitum food, not water (following glm).
Housing: rats explicitly housed individually, so group_housing = no; reverse light cycle explicitly stated.
